pat: heads-up: deploy of q3x reranker shows ~0.02 MRR regression in prod A/B. offline harness reports small +0.1 MRR. the delta is concentrated on docs containing embedded JSON blobs and many rows (API reference pages). nina: that's interesting. do you have a failing example? pat: pasted sanitized example: ```json { "query": "stripe webhook retry behavior", "doc_id": "doc-5501", "title": "Webhooks and retries", "body_html": "

Retries

Use the following payload:

{\"id\":\"evt_1\",\"type\":\"payment_intent.succeeded\"}
...
Endpoint/webhooks
", "body_text": "Retries Use the following payload: {\"id\":\"evt_1\",\"type\":\"payment_intent.succeeded\"} Endpoint /webhooks ..." } ``` lee: couple hypotheses: 1) our offline harness stripped JSON and collapsed the preformatted section into one token run, but prod serving preserves raw punctuation causing different tokenization and shorter effective context for the useful text; 2) we do top-k candidate truncation earlier in the pipeline in prod (k=80) vs harness (k=120) which interacts with score quantization; 3) tie-breaker semantics differ (prod uses last_updated, harness stable by candidate id). nina: also check tokenizer: prod still on tokenizer v1.9, staging on v2.1. v2.1 splits punctuation inside JSON differently which can artificially boost scores in harness. quantization makes logits tighter so those tokenization-induced differences flip ranks. pat: repro plan i ran: reproduce harness with exact serving preproc (preserve_pre=true), tokenizer=v1.9, topk=80, tie-break=last_updated. command: ``` ./eval_harness --model reranker:q3x --cohort apiref_json_slice.jsonl \ --preproc=serving_preserve_pre --tokenizer=v1.9 --topk=80 \ --tie-break=last_updated --metrics mrr,ndcg --bootstrap 1000 \ --out=/tmp/apiref_repro.json ``` ops-bot: CI job created -> https://ci.internal/6143210000/jobs/11 :building_construction: lee: results? pat: after aligning all those knobs i get -0.018 MRR (close to prod). when forcing body_text-only or increasing topk to 120, scores converge and offline shows no regression. nina: mitigation ideas: short-term canonicalize serving input to prefer body_text when present (low-risk) OR increase topk at candidate pruning (higher cost). medium-term: unify preproc/tokenizer versions across environments and add a `apiref-json` slice to regression monitors. lee: we should also add a golden sample to the onboarding checklist that contains embedded JSON + tables and assert ordering parity across quant and fp32. also document candidate-pruning point in the serving flow. pat: i'll open hotfix PR to prefer body_text with a 30m canary. nina please add harness golden + monitor. lee will update onboarding doc. i'll own the rollout. ops-bot: Patch PR created: https://git.internal/infra/patch/1420 — CI: https://ci.internal/6143210000/jobs/12 :white_check_mark: nina: filed issue #962: add apiref-json slice and tokenizer parity check to model bring-up. pat: rolling hotfix now, watching metrics for 45m. thanks all :thumbsup:
